patch_description: Add a deterministic directed polish phase after Phase 4. It sweeps the ~10 smallest triangles in ascending area order; for each binding vertex it probes moves along the outward normal of the opposite edge (analytically: rotate the edge vector by 90°, oriented away from the vertex), with step-halving on failure. This targets exactly the binding constraints, complementing the existing stochastic polish (which Gen 31 showed fails by moving only within the minimal triangle). Random kicks (20% budget) retain exploration. For the smallest triangle {i,j,k}, moving vertex i along the outward normal of edge (j,k) increases that triangle's area at the maximal local rate (gradient direction of |cross|), so a halving search from step 0.01 converges quickly to any available improvement. Repeat sweeps until no sweep improves.
